Explore the repo /Users/michael/Development/michaelkrog/Pathland to map how "assets" (images today; audio/video not yet supported) flow through every layer. I'm planning how to handle assets (images, audio, video) in the Pathland protocol.

Report back thoroughly on:

1. **IMAGE component + IMAGE_SOURCE (0x1002)**: how it's declared in `lib/rust/crates/pathland-core/src/constants.rs`, and how the HTML renderer (`lib/rust/crates/pathland-render-html/src/lib.rs`, the IMAGE arm), the TS DOM client (`lib/typescript/src/elements.ts`, `apply.ts`, `classes.ts` — image shell, IMAGE_SOURCE apply, CONTENT_MODE objectFit), the GTK renderer (`lib/rust/crates/pathland-render-gtk/src/lib.rs` — GtkPicture), and the Java DSL (`lib/java/pathland-view/src/main/java/com/pathland/view/Image.java`) each handle it. Quote the relevant code.

2. **CONTENT_MODE (0x001C), ASPECT_RATIO (0x001B), WIDTH/HEIGHT FILL/HUG sizing** as they apply to images today (objectFit, aspect-ratio, sizeCss).

3. **How the demos serve asset bytes**: search `lib/java/pathland-quarkus-demo` and `lib/java/pathland-spring-boot-demo` for how icons/images (`icons/*.svg`, etc.) are served (static resource dirs, controllers, META-INF/resources, src/main/resources). What paths do the demo views reference (e.g. `Image.of("icons/home.svg")`)?

4. **Any existing audio/video/media/asset component or property** anywhere (spec/, core constants, renderers, DSLs) — I believe none exist; confirm.

5. **The Java DSL Image API** (Image.java: factories, Signal overloads, modifiers used on images), and the `Label`/icon usage in `lib/java/pathland-demo-views/src/main/java/com/pathland/demo/sidebar/Sidebar.java`.

6. **Alt text / accessibility label** on images: how `LABEL` (0x200A) / `.accessibilityLabel` flows to HTML `alt` (if at all). Check `lib/rust/crates/pathland-render-html/src/lib.rs` IMAGE arm for `alt=`.

7. **The value_type mapping for IMAGE_SOURCE** (STRING) in `pathland_core::constants::value_type_for` and the Java `ValueTypes.forProperty`.

Be very thorough and quote exact code with file:line references.
I'll explore the repository systematically, starting with the key files across each layer.

1: //! Protocol constants: categories, commands, component types, value types, flags.
2: //!
3: //! These constants are part of the wire protocol (see `spec/OPCODE.md`) and MUST
4: //! NOT be renumbered once released. Component types were renumbered pre-release
5: //! to the grouped ranges in `spec/PRIMITIVES.md` (wire version stays 1).
6: 
7: /// Opcode categories (`Category` field, u8).
8: pub mod category {
9:     /// Tree mutations (guest → host): node create/delete/insert/remove/move.
10:     pub const TREE: u8 = 0x01;
11:     /// Properties and design tokens (guest → host): the constraint properties
12:     /// (spacing, padding, alignment, …) that native renderers use to lay out
13:     /// native elements. The engine does NOT emit rects.
14:     pub const STYLE: u8 = 0x02;
15:     /// Raw input events (host → guest): pointer down/move/up, key down/up.
16:     pub const EVENT: u8 = 0x03;
17:     /// Control (both directions): reset, environment, custom data.
18:     pub const META: u8 = 0x04;
19: }
20: 
21: /// Commands within the `TREE` category.
22: pub mod tree {
23:     /// `A=nodeId, B=componentType (u16, low)`
24:     pub const CREATE_NODE: u8 = 0x01;
25:     /// `A=nodeId`
26:     pub const DELETE_NODE: u8 = 0x02;
27:     /// `A=parentId, B=childId, C=index` (append is `C = u32::MAX`, see [`crate::APPEND`])
28:     pub const INSERT_CHILD: u8 = 0x03;
29:     /// `A=parentId, B=childId`
30:     pub const REMOVE_CHILD: u8 = 0x04;
31:     /// `A=parentId, B=childId, C=newIndex` (append is `C = u32::MAX`, see [`crate::APPEND`])
32:     pub const MOVE_CHILD: u8 = 0x05;
33: }
34: 
35: /// Commands within the `STYLE` category.
36: pub mod style {
37:     /// `A=nodeId, B=(valueType << 16) | propertyId, C=value`
38:     pub const SET_PROPERTY: u8 = 0x01;
39:     /// `A=arenaRef (path), B=valueType (u8), C=value`
40:     pub const SET_DESIGN_TOKEN: u8 = 0x02;
41:     /// `A=nodeId, B=arenaRef (utf8)`
42:     pub const SET_TEXT: u8 = 0x03;
43:     /// **Draft.** `A=nodeId, B=days since epoch (I32), C=millis of day (U32)` —
44:     /// set a node's date value (e.g. a `DATE_PICKER`); see
45:     /// `spec/PRIMITIVES.md` / `spec/OPCODE.md`.
46:     pub const SET_DATE: u8 = 0x04;
47: }
48: 
49: /// Commands within the `EVENT` category.
50: ///
51: /// Events are **raw inputs** (host → guest), each carrying a host-resolved
52: /// `targetId`. High-level interpretations (tap, drag, long-press) are built by
53: /// the guest/app from these raw inputs and are NOT part of the protocol.
54: pub mod event {
55:     /// `A=targetId, B=x (f32), C=y (f32)` (Flags `POINTER_SECONDARY`)
56:     pub const POINTER_DOWN: u8 = 0x01;
57:     /// `A=targetId, B=x (f32), C=y (f32)` (Flags `HOVER_ENTER` / `HOVER_LEAVE`)
58:     pub const POINTER_MOVE: u8 = 0x02;
59:     /// `A=targetId, B=x (f32), C=y (f32)` (Flags `POINTER_SECONDARY`)
60:     pub const POINTER_UP: u8 = 0x03;
61:     /// `A=targetId, B=keyCode (u16, low), C=modifiers (u8, low)` (Flags `KEY_REPEAT`)
62:     pub const KEY_DOWN: u8 = 0x04;
63:     /// `A=targetId, B=keyCode (u16, low), C=modifiers (u8, low)`
64:     pub const KEY_UP: u8 = 0x05;
65:     /// `A=targetId, B=value (f32)` — a control's value changed (host → guest).
66:     /// The renderer resolves the control's semantic value (e.g. a slider thumb
67:     /// dragged to a point on its track); the guest/app writes it into its state.
68:     pub const VALUE_CHANGED: u8 = 0x06;
69:     /// `A=targetId, B=string offset` — a text field's value changed (host →
70:     /// guest). The new text lives in the batch's string section, referenced by
71:     /// the *relative* offset in `B` (the same convention as `STYLE::SET_TEXT`).
72:     pub const TEXT_CHANGED: u8 = 0x07;
73:     /// **Draft.** `A=targetId, B=focused (0/1)` — a node gained/lost focus.
74:     pub const FOCUS_CHANGED: u8 = 0x08;
75:     /// **Draft.** `A=targetId, B=editing (0/1)` — an editing session began/ended.
76:     pub const EDITING_CHANGED: u8 = 0x09;
77:     /// **Draft.** `A=targetId, B=0` — the user committed a field (onSubmit).
78:     pub const SUBMIT: u8 = 0x0A;
79:     /// **Draft.** `A=targetId, B=offsetX (f32), C=offsetY (f32)` — scroll offset.
80:     pub const SCROLL: u8 = 0x0B;
81:     /// **Draft.** `A=targetId, B=deltaX (f32), C=deltaY (f32)` — wheel/trackpad.
82:     pub const WHEEL: u8 = 0x0C;
83:     /// **Draft.** `A=targetId, B=days since epoch (I32), C=millis of day (U32)`
84:     /// — a `DATE_PICKER`'s value changed (matches `STYLE::SET_DATE`).
85:     pub const DATE_CHANGED: u8 = 0x0D;
86:     /// **Draft.** Global navigation request (host → guest), never node-keyed.
87:     /// With the `NAVIGATE_URL` flag, `B` is a string offset (event arena /
88:     /// batch string section) to the destination URL; without it, the event means
89:     /// "back one step" (native back affordance) and `B`/`C` are ignored.
90:     pub const NAVIGATE: u8 = 0x0E;
91: }
92: 
93: /// Commands within the `META` category.
94: pub mod meta {
95:     /// Host must clear all rendered output.
96:     pub const RESET: u8 = 0x01;
97:     /// `A=fieldId (u16, low), B=field value` — a platform environment field
98:     /// (host → guest); see [`crate::environment`]. An extensible field family:
99:     /// each opcode sets one field (viewport, initial route, …).
100:     pub const ENVIRONMENT: u8 = 0x02;
101:     /// The host (renderer) requests a full snapshot of the current tree
102:     /// (host → guest). `A/B/C = 0`. Used for reconnect/gap recovery.
103:     pub const RESYNC: u8 = 0x03;
104: }
105: 
106: /// Environment field ids for `META::ENVIRONMENT` (host → guest).
107: ///
108: /// Each opcode sets one platform environment field; new fields are new ids, never
109: /// new commands (spec/OPCODE.md §Environment fields).
110: pub mod environment {
111:     /// Viewport width in logical points (f32 in `B`).
112:     pub const VIEWPORT_WIDTH: u16 = 0x0001;
113:     /// Viewport height in logical points (f32 in `B`).
114:     pub const VIEWPORT_HEIGHT: u16 = 0x0002;
115:     /// The initial route/deep-link path (STRING: `B` is a string-section/event-arena
116:     /// offset — the `TEXT_CHANGED`/`NAVIGATE` dual convention).
117:     pub const ROUTE: u16 = 0x0003;
118: }
119: 
120: /// Flag bits used across categories.
121: pub mod flag {
122:     /// `POINTER_DOWN` / `POINTER_UP`: secondary button (bit 0).
123:     pub const POINTER_SECONDARY: u16 = 0x0001;
124:     /// `POINTER_MOVE`: pointer is entering/hovering (bit 0).
125:     pub const HOVER_ENTER: u16 = 0x0001;
126:     /// `POINTER_MOVE`: pointer is leaving (bit 1).
127:     pub const HOVER_LEAVE: u16 = 0x0002;
128:     /// `KEY_DOWN`: key repeat (bit 1).
129:     pub const KEY_REPEAT: u16 = 0x0002;
130:     /// `NAVIGATE`: `B` is a URL string offset (bit 0). Without this flag the
131:     /// event is a back request.
132:     pub const NAVIGATE_URL: u16 = 0x0001;
133: }
134: 
135: /// Bits for the `EVENT_LISTENERS` semantic property (a u32 bitmask).
136: ///
137: /// Each bit requests that a renderer attach native input recognition for the
138: /// matching raw-input event and report it for that node — so any element (not
139: /// just a button) can emit raw events. Bits are independent of the `EVENT`
140: /// command ids; more event kinds can be added later.
141: pub mod listener {
142:     /// `POINTER_DOWN` events (bit 0).
143:     pub const POINTER_DOWN: u32 = 1 << 0;
144:     /// `POINTER_MOVE` events (bit 1).
145:     pub const POINTER_MOVE: u32 = 1 << 1;
146:     /// `POINTER_UP` events (bit 2).
147:     pub const POINTER_UP: u32 = 1 << 2;
148:     /// `KEY_DOWN` events (bit 3).
149:     pub const KEY_DOWN: u32 = 1 << 3;
150:     /// `KEY_UP` events (bit 4).
151:     pub const KEY_UP: u32 = 1 << 4;
152:     /// **Draft.** `FOCUS_CHANGED` events (bit 5).
153:     pub const FOCUS: u32 = 1 << 5;
154:     /// **Draft.** `EDITING_CHANGED` events (bit 6).
155:     pub const EDITING: u32 = 1 << 6;
156:     /// **Draft.** `SUBMIT` events (bit 7).
157:     pub const SUBMIT: u32 = 1 << 7;
158:     /// **Draft.** `SCROLL` events (bit 8).
159:     pub const SCROLL: u32 = 1 << 8;
160:     /// **Draft.** `WHEEL` events (bit 9).
161:     pub const WHEEL: u32 = 1 << 9;
162: 
163:     /// All pointer events (down + move + up).
164:     pub const POINTER: u32 = POINTER_DOWN | POINTER_MOVE | POINTER_UP;
165: }
166: 
167: /// Bits for the `BORDER_EDGES` style property (a u32 bitmask).
168: ///
169: /// Each bit selects one edge of a node's border. `LEADING`/`TRAILING` are
170: /// direction-aware; a renderer resolves them to physical `left`/`right`
171: /// according to its layout direction (LTR by default).
172: pub mod border_edges {
173:     /// Top edge (bit 0).
174:     pub const TOP: u32 = 1 << 0;
175:     /// Leading edge (bit 1) — physical left in LTR.
176:     pub const LEADING: u32 = 1 << 1;
177:     /// Bottom edge (bit 2).
178:     pub const BOTTOM: u32 = 1 << 2;
179:     /// Trailing edge (bit 3) — physical right in LTR.
180:     pub const TRAILING: u32 = 1 << 3;
181: 
182:     /// All four edges.
183:     pub const ALL: u32 = TOP | LEADING | BOTTOM | TRAILING;
184: }
185: 
186: /// Value types for `STYLE` properties (u8, encoded in the high byte of `B`).
187: pub mod value_type {
188:     pub const U8: u8 = 0x01;
189:     pub const U32: u8 = 0x02;
190:     pub const I32: u8 = 0x03;
191:     pub const F32: u8 = 0x04;
192:     pub const STRING: u8 = 0x05;
193:     pub const ENUM: u8 = 0x06;
194:     pub const COLOR: u8 = 0x07;
195:     pub const DESIGN_TOKEN: u8 = 0x08;
196: }
197: 
198: /// Component types (u16, encoded in the low half of `B` of `TREE::CREATE_NODE`).
199: ///
200: /// IDs are grouped into three definitive ranges (see `spec/PRIMITIVES.md`):
201: /// Primitive Drawing `0x01`–`0x0F`, Layout & Container `0x10`–`0x1F`, Semantic
202: /// Control `0x20`–`0x2F`, plus the utility `COMMENT` at `0x7F`. Renumbered
203: /// pre-release (wire version stays 1).
204: pub mod component_type {
205:     // ── Primitive Drawing & Visual Nodes (0x01–0x0F) ────────────────────────
206:     /// Standard styled text display.
207:     pub const TEXT: u16 = 0x01;
208:     /// Raster, vector, or system icon asset.
209:     pub const IMAGE: u16 = 0x02;
210:     /// **Draft.** Solid color / layout-filling background view.
211:     pub const COLOR: u16 = 0x03;
212:     /// **Draft.** Vector geometry (`SHAPE_KIND` selects the shape).
213:     pub const SHAPE: u16 = 0x04;
214:     /// **Draft.** Axis-aligned separator line.
215:     pub const DIVIDER: u16 = 0x05;
216:     /// Flexible expanding layout filler.
217:     pub const SPACER: u16 = 0x06;
218:     /// **Draft.** Determinate progress or activity indicator.
219:     pub const PROGRESS_VIEW: u16 = 0x07;
220:     /// **Draft.** Range meter against a scale (read-only).
221:     pub const GAUGE: u16 = 0x08;
222:     // 0x09–0x0F reserved (future drawing nodes).
223: 
224:     // ── Layout & Container Primitives (0x10–0x1F) ───────────────────────────
225:     /// Vertical flex stack.
226:     pub const VSTACK: u16 = 0x10;
227:     /// Horizontal flex stack.
228:     pub const HSTACK: u16 = 0x11;
229:     /// **Draft.** Depth-overlapping layer stack.
230:     pub const ZSTACK: u16 = 0x12;
231:     /// Static 2D matrix grid (eagerly rendered).
232:     pub const GRID: u16 = 0x13;
233:     /// Scrollable content container.
234:     pub const SCROLLVIEW: u16 = 0x14;
235:     /// **Draft.** Virtualized vertical grid.
236:     pub const LAZY_VGRID: u16 = 0x15;
237:     /// **Draft.** Virtualized horizontal grid.
238:     pub const LAZY_HGRID: u16 = 0x16;
239:     // 0x17–0x1A reserved (formerly composite views, removed).
240:     /// **Draft.** Virtualized vertical stack.
241:     pub const LAZY_VSTACK: u16 = 0x1B;
242:     /// **Draft.** Virtualized horizontal stack.
243:     pub const LAZY_HSTACK: u16 = 0x1C;
244:     // 0x1D–0x1F reserved (future layout nodes).
245: 
246:     // ── Semantic Control Nodes (0x20–0x2F) ──────────────────────────────────
247:     /// Action trigger control.
248:     pub const BUTTON: u16 = 0x20;
249:     /// Single-line text input (secure variant via `IS_SECURE`).
250:     pub const TEXT_FIELD: u16 = 0x21;
251:     /// **Draft.** Multi-line text editing area.
252:     pub const TEXT_EDITOR: u16 = 0x22;
253:     // 0x23 reserved.
254:     /// Boolean control; the visual variant is `TOGGLE_STYLE`
255:     /// (`Switch`/`Checkbox`/`Button`).
256:     pub const TOGGLE: u16 = 0x24;
257:     /// Continuous or stepped numeric range control.
258:     pub const SLIDER: u16 = 0x25;
259:     /// **Draft.** Discrete increment/decrement control.
260:     pub const STEPPER: u16 = 0x26;
261:     /// **Draft.** Date & time selection control (`STYLE::SET_DATE` value).
262:     pub const DATE_PICKER: u16 = 0x27;
263:     /// **Draft.** Selection control (options are child nodes).
264:     pub const PICKER: u16 = 0x28;
265:     /// **Draft.** Contextual action trigger + popover container.
266:     pub const MENU: u16 = 0x29;
267:     /// **Draft.** Native system color picker control.
268:     pub const COLOR_PICKER: u16 = 0x2A;
269:     // 0x2B–0x2F reserved (future semantic controls).
270: 
271:     /// Opaque/debug node; renderers ignore it (no native element).
272:     pub const COMMENT: u16 = 0x7F;
273: }
274: 
275: /// Property IDs (u16, encoded in the low half of `B` of `STYLE::SET_PROPERTY`).
276: ///
277: /// IDs are specified in `spec/OPCODE.md` (carried forward from the historical protocol).
278: pub mod property_id {
279:     // Stack
280:     pub const SPACING: u16 = 0x0001;
281:     pub const ALIGNMENT: u16 = 0x0002;
282:     // 0x0003 reserved (formerly JUSTIFICATION; main-axis distribution is
283:     // expressed via a spacer element instead).
284:     // 0x0004 reserved (formerly PADDING; now a styling modifier at 0x1011).
285:     pub const CONTENT_MARGINS: u16 = 0x0005;
286:     // Text
287:     pub const TEXT: u16 = 0x000A;
288:     pub const LINE_LIMIT: u16 = 0x000B;
289:     pub const TEXT_ALIGNMENT: u16 = 0x000C;
290:     pub const TRUNCATION_MODE: u16 = 0x000D;
291:     /// **Draft.** `SHAPE` geometry kind (F32 enum): `Circle`=0, `Rectangle`=1,
292:     /// `RoundedRectangle`=2, `Capsule`=3, `Ellipse`=4, `Path`=5.
293:     pub const SHAPE_KIND: u16 = 0x0006;
294:     // Layout modifiers (draft, 0x000E–0x001D)
295:     /// **Draft.** Post-layout translation, x (F32). `.offset(x:y:)`.
296:     pub const OFFSET_X: u16 = 0x000E;
297:     /// **Draft.** Post-layout translation, y (F32).
298:     pub const OFFSET_Y: u16 = 0x000F;
299:     /// **Draft.** Absolute position within the parent, x (F32). `.position(x:y:)`.
300:     pub const POSITION_X: u16 = 0x0010;
301:     /// **Draft.** Absolute position within the parent, y (F32).
302:     pub const POSITION_Y: u16 = 0x0011;
303:     /// **Draft.** Minimum width (F32). `.frame(minWidth:...)`.
304:     pub const MIN_WIDTH: u16 = 0x0012;
305:     /// **Draft.** Ideal width (F32).
306:     pub const IDEAL_WIDTH: u16 = 0x0013;
307:     /// **Draft.** Maximum width (F32).
308:     pub const MAX_WIDTH: u16 = 0x0014;
309:     /// **Draft.** Minimum height (F32).
310:     pub const MIN_HEIGHT: u16 = 0x0015;
311:     /// **Draft.** Ideal height (F32).
312:     pub const IDEAL_HEIGHT: u16 = 0x0016;
313:     /// **Draft.** Maximum height (F32).
314:     pub const MAX_HEIGHT: u16 = 0x0017;
315:     /// **Draft.** Fixed-size hint, horizontal (U8 0/1). `.fixedSize()`.
316:     pub const FIXED_SIZE_HORIZONTAL: u16 = 0x0018;
317:     /// **Draft.** Fixed-size hint, vertical (U8 0/1).
318:     pub const FIXED_SIZE_VERTICAL: u16 = 0x0019;
319:     /// **Draft.** Layout priority (F32). `.layoutPriority(_:)`.
320:     pub const LAYOUT_PRIORITY: u16 = 0x001A;
321:     /// **Draft.** Aspect ratio (F32). `.aspectRatio(_:)`.
322:     pub const ASPECT_RATIO: u16 = 0x001B;
323:     /// **Draft.** Content mode (F32 enum): `Fit`=0, `Fill`=1.
324:     pub const CONTENT_MODE: u16 = 0x001C;
325:     /// **Draft.** Minimum scale factor (F32). `.minimumScaleFactor(_:)`.
326:     pub const MINIMUM_SCALE_FACTOR: u16 = 0x001D;
327:     // Style (0x1000 range)
328:     pub const BACKGROUND_COLOR: u16 = 0x1001;
329:     /// **Draft.** Image source (STRING: a resource name, file path, or URL).
330:     pub const IMAGE_SOURCE: u16 = 0x1002;
331:     pub const BORDER_WIDTH: u16 = 0x1003;
332:     pub const BORDER_COLOR: u16 = 0x1004;
333:     pub const BORDER_RADIUS: u16 = 0x1005;
334:     pub const PADDING_STYLE: u16 = 0x1006;
335:     pub const FONT_SIZE: u16 = 0x1007;
336:     pub const FONT_WEIGHT: u16 = 0x1008;
337:     pub const FONT_FAMILY: u16 = 0x1009;
338:     pub const COLOR: u16 = 0x100A;
339:     pub const WIDTH: u16 = 0x100B;
340:     pub const HEIGHT: u16 = 0x100C;
341:     pub const OPACITY: u16 = 0x100D;
342:     pub const VISIBLE: u16 = 0x100E;
343:     pub const Z_INDEX: u16 = 0x100F;
344:     pub const CLIPS_TO_BOUNDS: u16 = 0x1010;
345:     pub const PADDING: u16 = 0x1011;
346:     pub const PADDING_TOP: u16 = 0x1012;
347:     pub const PADDING_RIGHT: u16 = 0x1013;
348:     pub const PADDING_BOTTOM: u16 = 0x1014;
349:     pub const PADDING_LEFT: u16 = 0x1015;
350:     /// `BORDER_EDGES` — a u32 bitmask (see [`crate::border_edges`]) selecting
351:     /// which edges of a node's border are drawn.
352:     pub const BORDER_EDGES: u16 = 0x1016;
353:     // Text-format modifiers (draft, 0x1017–0x1020)
354:     /// **Draft.** Font style (F32 enum): `Normal`=0, `Italic`=1.
355:     pub const FONT_STYLE: u16 = 0x1017;
356:     /// **Draft.** Font design (F32 enum): `Default`=0, `Serif`=1, `Rounded`=2,
357:     /// `Monospaced`=3.
358:     pub const FONT_DESIGN: u16 = 0x1018;
359:     /// **Draft.** Font width (F32, 0.5–1.5, 1.0 default).

170:             if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(prop) {
171:                 css.push_str(&format!("{side}:{v};"));
172:             } else if let Some(v) = f32p(prop) {
173:                 if v > 0.0 {
174:                     css.push_str(&format!("{side}:{};", px(v)));
175:                 }
176:             }
177:         }
178:         // WIDTH/HEIGHT: fixed values inline as px; FILL (-1) → `100%` (expand to
179:         // the available space in a flex parent — SwiftUI `maxWidth/maxHeight:
180:         // .infinity`). HUG_CONTENT (-2) is left to the intrinsic size.
181:         if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(property_id::WIDTH) {
182:             css.push_str(&format!("width:{v};"));
183:         } else if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::WIDTH) {
184:             if v != pathland_core::size::HUG_CONTENT {
185:                 css.push_str(&format!("width:{};", size_css(v)));
186:             }
187:         }
188:         if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(property_id::HEIGHT) {
189:             css.push_str(&format!("height:{v};"));
190:         } else if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::HEIGHT) {
191:             if v != pathland_core::size::HUG_CONTENT {
192:                 css.push_str(&format!("height:{};", size_css(v)));
193:             }
194:         }
195:         if let (Some(x), Some(y)) = (f32p(property_id::OFFSET_X), f32p(property_id::OFFSET_Y)) {
196:             if x != 0.0 || y != 0.0 {
197:                 css.push_str(&format!("transform:translate({}px, {}px);", x, y));
198:             }
199:         } else {
200:             if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::POSITION_X) {
201:                 if v != 0.0 {
202:                     css.push_str(&format!("left:{};", px(v)));
203:                 }
204:             }
205:             if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::POSITION_Y) {
206:                 if v != 0.0 {
207:                     css.push_str(&format!("top:{};", px(v)));
208:                 }
209:             }
210:         }
211: 
212:         // Typography (arbitrary size/weight inline).
213:         if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(property_id::FONT_SIZE) {
214:             css.push_str(&format!("font-size:{v};"));
215:         } else if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::FONT_SIZE) {
216:             if v > 0.0 {
217:                 css.push_str(&format!("font-size:{};", px(v)));
218:             }
219:         }
220:         if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(property_id::FONT_WEIGHT) {
221:             css.push_str(&format!("font-weight:{v};"));
222:         } else if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::FONT_WEIGHT) {
223:             if v > 0.0 {
224:                 css.push_str(&format!("font-weight:{v};"));
225:             }
226:         }
227:         if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(property_id::BORDER_RADIUS) {
228:             css.push_str(&format!("border-radius:{v};"));
229:         } else if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::BORDER_RADIUS) {
230:             if v != 0.0 {
231:                 css.push_str(&format!("border-radius:{};", px(v)));
232:             }
233:         }
234: 
235:         // Effects (filters, rotation, scale, shadow, opacity, z-index) inline.
236:         let mut filters: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
237:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::BLUR_RADIUS) {
238:             filters.push(format!("blur({}px)", v));
239:         }
240:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::SATURATION) {
241:             filters.push(format!("saturate({v})"));
242:         }
243:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::CONTRAST) {
244:             filters.push(format!("contrast({v})"));
245:         }
246:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::BRIGHTNESS) {
247:             filters.push(format!("brightness({v})"));
248:         }
249:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::GRAYSCALE) {
250:             filters.push(format!("grayscale({v})"));
251:         }
252:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::HUE_ROTATION) {
253:             filters.push(format!("hue-rotate({v}deg)"));
254:         }
255:         if !filters.is_empty() {
256:             css.push_str(&format!("filter:{};", filters.join(" ")));
257:         }
258:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::ROTATION_DEGREES) {
259:             if v != 0.0 {
260:                 css.push_str(&format!("transform:rotate({v}deg);"));
261:             }
262:         }
263:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::SCALE) {
264:             if v != 1.0 {
265:                 css.push_str(&format!("transform:scale({v});"));
266:             }
267:         }
268:         // Shadow (accumulate x/y/radius/color — simplified to radius+color inline).
269:         if let (Some(r), Some(color_bits)) = (
270:             f32p(property_id::SHADOW_RADIUS),
271:             self.properties.get(&property_id::SHADOW_COLOR).copied(),
272:         ) {
273:             if r != 0.0 {
274:                 let x = f32p(property_id::SHADOW_X).unwrap_or(0.0);
275:                 let y = f32p(property_id::SHADOW_Y).unwrap_or(0.0);
276:                 let color = self
277:                     .token_ref(property_id::SHADOW_COLOR)
278:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| rgba(color_bits));
279:                 css.push_str(&format!("box-shadow:{x}px {y}px {r}px {color};"));
280:             }
281:         }
282:         if let Some(v) = self.token_ref(property_id::OPACITY) {
283:             css.push_str(&format!("opacity:{v};"));
284:         } else if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::OPACITY) {
285:             if v < 1.0 {
286:                 css.push_str(&format!("opacity:{v};"));
287:             }
288:         }
289:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::Z_INDEX) {
290:             css.push_str(&format!("z-index:{};", v as i32));
291:         }
292: 
293:         // Enum-derived properties (previously Tailwind classes) now inline.
294:         // ALIGNMENT cross-axis (Leading=0, Center=1, Trailing=2, Fill=3 → default stretch).
295:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::ALIGNMENT) {
296:             css.push_str(&format!(
297:                 "align-items:{};",
298:                 match v as u8 {
299:                     0 => "flex-start",
300:                     1 => "center",
301:                     2 => "flex-end",
302:                     _ => "stretch",
303:                 }
304:             ));
305:         }
306:         // TEXT_ALIGNMENT (Leading=0, Center=1, Trailing=2).
307:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::TEXT_ALIGNMENT) {
308:             css.push_str(&format!(
309:                 "text-align:{};",
310:                 match (v as u8).min(2) {
311:                     0 => "left",
312:                     1 => "center",
313:                     _ => "right",
314:                 }
315:             ));
316:         }
317:         // TEXT_CASE (None=0, Uppercase=1, Lowercase=2).
318:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::TEXT_CASE) {
319:             css.push_str(&format!(
320:                 "text-transform:{};",
321:                 match v as u8 {
322:                     1 => "uppercase",
323:                     2 => "lowercase",
324:                     _ => "none",
325:                 }
326:             ));
327:         }
328:         // VISIBLE=0 → hidden.
329:         if let Some(bits) = self.properties.get(&property_id::VISIBLE) {
330:             if *bits == 0 {
331:                 css.push_str("display:none;");
332:             }
333:         }
334:         // FONT_STYLE italic.
335:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::FONT_STYLE) {
336:             if v != 0.0 {
337:                 css.push_str("font-style:italic;");
338:             }
339:         }
340:         // FONT_DESIGN (Default=0, Serif=1, Rounded=2, Monospaced=3).
341:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::FONT_DESIGN) {
342:             css.push_str(&format!(
343:                 "font-family:{};",
344:                 match v as u8 {
345:                     1 => "Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif",
346:                     2 => "ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif",
347:                     3 => "ui-monospace, monospace",
348:                     _ => "inherit",
349:                 }
350:             ));
351:         }
352:         // UNDERLINE / STRIKETHROUGH.
353:         let mut decoration = Vec::new();
354:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::UNDERLINE) {
355:             if v != 0.0 {
356:                 decoration.push("underline");
357:             }
358:         }
359:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::STRIKETHROUGH) {
360:             if v != 0.0 {
361:                 decoration.push("line-through");
362:             }
363:         }
364:         if !decoration.is_empty() {
365:             css.push_str(&format!("text-decoration:{};", decoration.join(" ")));
366:         }
367:         // CLIPS_TO_BOUNDS → overflow hidden.
368:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::CLIPS_TO_BOUNDS) {
369:             if v != 0.0 {
370:                 css.push_str("overflow:hidden;");
371:             }
372:         }
373:         // ALLOWS_HIT_TESTING (inverted: absent = allowed).
374:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::ALLOWS_HIT_TESTING) {
375:             if v == 0.0 {
376:                 css.push_str("pointer-events:none;");
377:             }
378:         }
379:         // COLOR_INVERT.
380:         if let Some(v) = f32p(property_id::COLOR_INVERT) {
381:             if v != 0.0 {
382:                 css.push_str("filter:invert(1);");
383:             }
384:         }
385:         // TRUNCATION_MODE → ellipsis.
386:         if self.properties.contains_key(&property_id::TRUNCATION_MODE) {
387:             css.push_str("text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;");
388:         }
389: 
390:         css
391:     }

393:     /// Border CSS, decoded from `BORDER_WIDTH`/`BORDER_COLOR`/`BORDER_RADIUS`/
394:     /// `BORDER_EDGES` (empty when the node has no border).
395:     fn border_style(&self) -> String {
396:         let width = match self.token_ref(property_id::BORDER_WIDTH) {
397:             Some(v) => v,
398:             None => {
399:                 let Some(width_bits) = self.properties.get(&property_id::BORDER_WIDTH) else {
400:                     return String::new();
401:                 };
402:                 format!("{}px", f32::from_bits(*width_bits))
403:             }
404:         };
405:         let color = match self.token_ref(property_id::BORDER_COLOR) {
406:             Some(v) => v,
407:             None => rgba(
408:                 self.properties
409:                     .get(&property_id::BORDER_COLOR)
410:                     .copied()
411:                     .unwrap_or(0xFF00_0000),
412:             ),
413:         };
414:         let edges = self
415:             .properties
416:             .get(&property_id::BORDER_EDGES)
417:             .copied()
418:             .unwrap_or(border_edges::ALL);
419: 
420:         let mut css = String::new();
421:         for (flag, side) in [
422:             (border_edges::TOP, "top"),
423:             (border_edges::LEADING, "left"),
424:             (border_edges::BOTTOM, "bottom"),
425:             (border_edges::TRAILING, "right"),
426:         ] {
427:             if edges & flag != 0 {
428:                 css.push_str(&format!("border-{side}:{width} solid {color};"));
429:             }
430:         }
431:         css
432:     }
433: }

435: /// Unpack a `0xAARRGGBB` color into `(r, g, b, alpha)` where `alpha` is `0..1`.
436: fn unpack_color(argb: u32) -> (u32, u32, u32, f32) {
437:     let r = (argb >> 16) & 0xFF;
438:     let g = (argb >> 8) & 0xFF;
439:     let b = argb & 0xFF;
440:     let a = ((argb >> 24) & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0;
441:     (r, g, b, a)
442: }
443: 
444: /// A `0xAARRGGBB` color as a CSS `rgba(r,g,b,a)` string.
445: fn rgba(argb: u32) -> String {
446:     let (r, g, b, a) = unpack_color(argb);
447:     format!("rgba({r},{g},{b},{a})")
448: }

450: /// A `WIDTH`/`HEIGHT` hint as CSS: `FILL` (-1) → `100%`, `HUG_CONTENT` (-2) →

455:     } else if v == pathland_core::size::HUG_CONTENT {
456:         "fit-content".to_string()

473: /// Convert days since the Unix epoch (negative = before 1970) to a Gregorian
474: /// `(year, month, day)` using the civil-from-days algorithm.
475: fn days_to_date(days: i32) -> (i32, u32, u32) {
476:     let z = i64::from(days) + 719_468;
477:     let era = if z >= 0 { z } else { z - 146_096 } / 146_097;
478:     let doe = z - era * 146_097;
479:     let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36524 - doe / 146_096) / 365;
480:     let y = yoe + era * 400;
481:     let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
482:     let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
483:     let d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1;
484:     let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 };
485:     let y = if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y };
486:     (y as i32, m as u32, d as u32)
487: }

489: /// Millis of day → `(hours, minutes, seconds)`.
490: fn millis_to_hms(millis: u32) -> (u32, u32, u32) {
491:     let total = millis / 1000;
492:     (total / 3600, (total % 3600) / 60, total % 60)
493: }

513: /// ARIA attributes from `ROLE` / `STATE` / `ENABLED`. The `ROLE` map is the
514: /// canonical `role_spec` (also generated into the DOM client), so a role
515: /// resolves to the same ARIA attribute on both renderers; roles that render as
516: /// a semantic element (or are conveyed by a native control element) emit no
517: /// attribute.
518: fn aria_attrs(node: &Node) -> String {
519:     let mut attrs = String::new();
520:     if let Some(bits) = node.properties.get(&property_id::ROLE) {
521:         let code = f32::from_bits(*bits) as u8;
522:         let kind = role_spec::shell_kind(node.component);
523:         if let Some(role) = role_spec::aria_role(kind, code) {
524:             attrs.push_str(&format!(" role=\"{role}\""));
525:         }
526:     }
527:     if let Some(bits) = node.properties.get(&property_id::STATE) {
528:         match f32::from_bits(*bits) as u8 {
529:             1 => attrs.push_str(" aria-disabled=\"true\""),
530:             3 => attrs.push_str(" aria-pressed=\"true\""),
531:             4 => attrs.push_str(" aria-selected=\"true\""),
532:             5 => attrs.push_str(" aria-expanded=\"true\""),
533:             6 => attrs.push_str(" aria-busy=\"true\""),
534:             _ => {}
535:         }
536:     }
537:     if let Some(bits) = node.properties.get(&property_id::ENABLED) {
538:         if *bits == 0 {
539:             attrs.push_str(" disabled");
540:         }
541:     }
542:     attrs
543: }

545: /// Decode a self-contained snapshot batch (opcodes + string section) into a
546: /// **transient** `id → Node` map. The map lives only for the duration of one
547: /// render call — the renderer retains nothing between calls.
548: fn decode(opcodes: &[Opcode], strings: &[u8]) -> (BTreeMap<u32, Node>, Tokens) {
549:     let mut nodes = BTreeMap::new();
550:     let mut tokens = Tokens::default();
551:     for op in opcodes {
552:         match op.category() {
553:             category::TREE => apply_tree(&mut nodes, op.command(), *op),
554:             category::STYLE => {
555:                 if op.command() == style::SET_DESIGN_TOKEN {
556:                     // Global override: A = arenaRef (token path), B = valueType,
557:                     // C = value (for STRING, an arenaRef to the value string).
558:                     if let Some(path) = strings_str(strings, op.a()) {
559:                         let vt = (op.b() & 0xFF) as u8;
560:                         let value = if vt == value_type::STRING {
561:                             strings_str(strings, op.c())
562:                                 .map(TokenValue::Str)
563:                                 .unwrap_or(TokenValue::U32(0))
564:                         } else {
565:                             TokenValue::from_wire(vt, op.c()).unwrap_or(TokenValue::U32(op.c()))
566:                         };
567:                         tokens.set(&path, vt, value);
568:                     }
569:                 } else {
570:                     apply_style(&mut nodes, op.command(), *op, strings);
571:                 }
572:             }
573:             _ => {}
574:         }
575:     }
576:     (nodes, tokens)
577: }

579: /// Read a `[u32 len][utf8]` entry from the batch's string section at a relative offset.
580: fn strings_str(strings: &[u8], offset: u32) -> Option<String> {
581:     let offset = offset as usize;
582:     if offset + 4 > strings.len() {
583:         return None;
584:     }
585:     let len = u32::from_le_bytes(strings[offset..offset + 4].try_into().ok()?) as usize;
586:     let start = offset + 4;
587:     if start + len > strings.len() {
588:         return None;
589:     }
590:     std::str::from_utf8(&strings[start..start + len]).ok().map(str::to_owned)
591: }

593: // --- Design tokens (spec/TOKENS.md) ---
594: 
595: /// `SET_DESIGN_TOKEN` overrides collected from a snapshot batch. `base` holds
596: /// light tokens (keyed by full path); `dark` holds `dark.`-prefixed overrides
597: /// (keyed by the bare path). Values are resolved [`TokenValue`]s (STRING values
598: /// are resolved from the batch's string section at decode time).
599: #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
600: struct Tokens {
601:     base: BTreeMap<String, (u8, TokenValue)>,
602:     dark: BTreeMap<String, (u8, TokenValue)>,
603: }
604: 
605: impl Tokens {
606:     fn set(&mut self, path: &str, value_type: u8, value: TokenValue) {
607:         if let Some(bare) = path.strip_prefix("dark.") {
608:             self.dark.insert(bare.to_string(), (value_type, value));
609:         } else {
610:             self.base.insert(path.to_string(), (value_type, value));
611:         }
612:     }
613: 
614:     /// Render the overrides as CSS rules: base tokens as `:root` rules, dark
615:     /// overrides inside `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` — the browser
616:     /// resolves the scheme natively, so SSR needs no client scheme knowledge.
617:     fn css(&self) -> String {
618:         let mut css = String::new();
619:         for (path, (vt, value)) in &self.base {
620:             css.push_str(&format!(
621:                 ":root{{{}:{};}}",
622:                 token_to_css_var(path),
623:                 token_css_value(path, *vt, value)
624:             ));
625:         }
626:         if !self.dark.is_empty() {
627:             let rules: String = self
628:                 .dark
629:                 .iter()
630:                 .map(|(path, (vt, value))| {
631:                     format!(":root{{{}:{};}}", token_to_css_var(path), token_css_value(path, *vt, value))
632:                 })
633:                 .collect();
634:             css.push_str(&format!("@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){{{rules}}}"));
635:         }
636:         css
637:     }
638: }
639: 
640: /// The canonical CSS custom property for a token path: `--pl-` prefix, `.` →
641: /// `-`. The `dark.` scheme prefix is stripped — the dark variant overrides the
642: /// same variable inside the media query (spec/TOKENS.md; the naming rules live
643: /// in [`token_spec`], which `pathland-ts-codegen` mirrors into the DOM client).
644: fn token_to_css_var(path: &str) -> String {
645:     let bare = path.strip_prefix(token_spec::DARK_PREFIX).unwrap_or(path);
646:     let name: String = bare
647:         .chars()
648:         .map(|c| if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_' { c } else { '-' })
649:         .collect();
650:     format!("{}{name}", token_spec::VAR_PREFIX)
651: }
652: 
653: /// Token paths whose F32 values are CSS lengths (emitted with `px`).
654: fn is_length_token(path: &str) -> bool {
655:     for prefix in token_spec::LENGTH_PREFIXES {
656:         if path.starts_with(prefix) {
657:             return true;
658:         }
659:     }
660:     for (prefix, suffix) in token_spec::LENGTH_PREFIX_SUFFIX {
661:         if path.starts_with(prefix) && path.ends_with(suffix) {
662:             return true;
663:         }
664:     }
665:     if token_spec::LENGTH_EXACT.contains(&path) {
666:         return true;
667:     }
668:     path.starts_with("elevation.")
669:         && token_spec::LENGTH_ELEVATION_SUFFIXES
670:             .iter()
671:             .any(|s| path.ends_with(s))
672: }
673: 
674: /// Render a token override value as a CSS value string: `STRING` values are
675: /// single-quoted (escaped); `F32` length tokens append `px`.
676: fn token_css_value(path: &str, _value_type: u8, value: &TokenValue) -> String {
677:     match value {
678:         TokenValue::Str(s) => format!("'{}'", s.replace('\\', "\\\\").replace('\'', "\\'")),
679:         TokenValue::Color(argb) => rgba(*argb),
680:         TokenValue::F32(v) => {
681:             if is_length_token(path) {
682:                 format!("{v}px")
683:             } else {
684:                 format!("{v}")
685:             }
686:         }
687:         TokenValue::I32(v) => format!("{v}"),
688:         TokenValue::U32(v) => format!("{v}"),
689:         TokenValue::U8(v) => format!("{v}"),
690:     }
691: }
692: 
693: /// Resolve a `DESIGN_TOKEN` property reference to a CSS expression. The
694: /// generative `space.<N>` family resolves to `calc(var(--pl-space-base) * N)`;
695: /// every other token resolves to `var(--pl-<path>)`.
696: fn resolve_token_ref(path: &str) -> String {
697:     let bare = path.strip_prefix(token_spec::DARK_PREFIX).unwrap_or(path);
698:     if let Some(rest) = bare.strip_prefix(token_spec::SPACE_FAMILY) {
699:         if rest.parse::<f64>().is_ok() {
700:             return format!("calc(var(--pl-space-base) * {rest})");
701:         }
702:     }
703:     format!("var({})", token_to_css_var(bare))
704: }
705: 
706: fn apply_tree(nodes: &mut BTreeMap<u32, Node>, command: u8, op: Opcode) {
707:     match command {
708:         tree::CREATE_NODE => {
709:             let id = op.a();
710:             let component = op.b() as u16;
711:             nodes.insert(id, Node::new(component));
712:         }
713:         tree::DELETE_NODE => {
714:             nodes.remove(&op.a());
715:         }
716:         tree::INSERT_CHILD => {
717:             let (parent, child) = (op.a(), op.b());
718:             if let Some(node) = nodes.get_mut(&parent) {
719:                 let index = op.c();
720:                 if index == pathland_core::APPEND {
721:                     node.children.push(child);
722:                 } else {
723:                     let index = (index as usize).min(node.children.len());
724:                     node.children.insert(index, child);
725:                 }
726:             }
727:         }
728:         tree::REMOVE_CHILD => {
729:             let (parent, child) = (op.a(), op.b());
730:             if let Some(node) = nodes.get_mut(&parent) {
731:                 node.children.retain(|&c| c != child);
732:             }
733:         }
734:         tree::MOVE_CHILD => {
735:             let (parent, child, index) = (op.a(), op.b(), op.c());
736:             if let Some(node) = nodes.get_mut(&parent) {
737:                 node.children.retain(|&c| c != child);
738:                 let index = (index as usize).min(node.children.len());
739:                 node.children.insert(index, child);
740:             }
741:         }
742:         _ => {}
743:     }
744: }
745: 
746: fn apply_style(nodes: &mut BTreeMap<u32, Node>, command: u8, op: Opcode, strings: &[u8]) {
747:     match command {
748:         style::SET_TEXT => {
749:             if let Some(text) = strings_str(strings, op.b()) {
750:                 if let Some(node) = nodes.get_mut(&op.a()) {
751:                     node.text = Some(text);
752:                 }
753:             }
754:         }
755:         style::SET_PROPERTY => {
756:             let property = (op.b() & 0xFFFF) as u16;
757:             if let Some(node) = nodes.get_mut(&op.a()) {
758:                 let vt = (op.b() >> 16) as u8;
759:                 if vt == value_type::STRING {
760:                     if let Some(text) = strings_str(strings, op.c()) {
761:                         node.strings.insert(property, text);
762:                     }
763:                 } else if vt == value_type::DESIGN_TOKEN {
764:                     // C = arenaRef to the token path; resolved at render time to
765:                     // `var(--pl-…)` / `calc(...)` (see `Node::token_ref`).
766:                     if let Some(path) = strings_str(strings, op.c()) {
767:                         node.token_refs.insert(property, path);
768:                     }
769:                 } else {
770:                     node.properties.insert(property, op.c());
771:                 }
772:             }
773:         }
774:         style::SET_DATE => {
775:             if let Some(node) = nodes.get_mut(&op.a()) {
776:                 // B = days since epoch (I32), C = millis of day (U32).
777:                 node.date = Some((op.b() as i32, op.c()));
778:             }
779:         }
780:         _ => {}
781:     }
782: }

784: /// A **stateless, streaming** HTML renderer. Each render call decodes a
785: /// self-contained snapshot batch into a transient map, walks it once, and
786: /// streams HTML text out — zero state retained across calls. A pure function
787: /// of the opcode stream (Renderer Statelessness).
788: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
789: pub struct HtmlRenderer {
790:     /// When enabled, every rendered node is prefixed with an HTML comment
791:     /// describing its component type and the modifiers (style properties)
792:     /// applied to it (`<!-- #1 VStack: spacing=4, alignment=Fill -->`). A
793:     /// debugging aid — off by default so production SSR stays lean.
794:     debug_comments: bool,
795: }
796: 
797: impl HtmlRenderer {
798:     /// Create a renderer (stateless; the same value serves every render).
799:     #[must_use]
800:     pub fn new() -> Self {
801:         Self {
802:             debug_comments: false,
803:         }
804:     }
805: 
806:     /// Enable/disable debug comments. When on, each rendered node is prefixed
807:     /// with an HTML comment naming its component and the modifiers applied
808:     /// (see [`crate::debug`]).
809:     #[must_use]
810:     pub fn with_debug_comments(mut self, on: bool) -> Self {
811:         self.debug_comments = on;
812:         self
813:     }
814: 
815:     /// Whether debug comments are enabled.
816:     #[must_use]
817:     pub fn debug_comments(&self) -> bool {
818:         self.debug_comments
819:     }
820: 
821:     /// Render the subtree rooted at `root` as a full HTML document.
822:     #[must_use]
823:     pub fn render_document(&self, opcodes: &[Opcode], strings: &[u8], root: u32) -> String {
824:         let (nodes, tokens) = decode(opcodes, strings);
825:         let body = self.render_node(&nodes, root);
826:         // Token overrides render as their own `<style data-pathland-tokens>`
827:         // element AFTER the built-in block so their `:root` variables win the
828:         // cascade (same specificity, later wins) — matching the JS DOM client's
829:         // `style[data-pathland-tokens]` element. No overrides → no element.
830:         let token_rules = tokens.css();
831:         let token_style = if token_rules.is_empty() {
832:             String::new()
833:         } else {
834:             format!("<style data-pathland-tokens>{token_rules}</style>\n")
835:         };
836:         format!(
837:             "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n\
838:              <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n\
839:              <title>Pathland</title>\n\
840:              <link rel=\"preconnect\" href=\"https://rsms.me/\">\n\
841:              <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"https://rsms.me/inter/inter.css\">\n\
842:              {}{}\n</head>\n<body>{body}</body>\n</html>\n",
843:             css::STYLE,
844:             token_style
845:         )
846:     }
847: 
848:     /// Render the subtree rooted at `root` as an HTML fragment (no `<html>`).
849:     /// `SET_DESIGN_TOKEN` overrides are applied to the document head by
850:     /// `render_document`; a fragment is assumed to be embedded in a document
851:     /// that already defines the token variables.
852:     #[must_use]
853:     pub fn render_fragment(&self, opcodes: &[Opcode], strings: &[u8], root: u32) -> String {
854:         let (nodes, _) = decode(opcodes, strings);
855:         self.render_node(&nodes, root)
856:     }
857: 
858:     fn render_node(&self, nodes: &BTreeMap<u32, Node>, id: u32) -> String {
859:         let Some(node) = nodes.get(&id) else {
860:             return String::new();
861:         };
862:         let children: String = node
863:             .children
864:             .iter()
865:             .map(|&child| self.render_node(nodes, child))
866:             .collect();
867:         let mut data_id = format!(" data-pathland-id=\"{id}\"");
868:         data_id.push_str(&slot_attrs(node));
869:         let css = format!("{}{}", node.style_css(), node.border_style());
870:         let style = style_attr(&css);
871:         let event = event_attrs(node);
872:         let aria = aria_attrs(node);
873:         // A semantic role may retag a generic div/span shell (role_spec);
874:         // control components keep their native element.
875:         let kind = role_spec::shell_kind(node.component);
876:         let semantic = role_spec::semantic_tag(kind, node.role_code());
877: 
878:         let element = match node.component {
879:             component_type::VSTACK => wrap_stack(id, "column", semantic, node, &children, &css, &event, &aria),
880:             component_type::HSTACK => wrap_stack(id, "row", semantic, node, &children, &css, &event, &aria),
881:             component_type::LAZY_VSTACK => {
882:                 wrap_stack(id, "column", semantic, node, &children, &css, &event, &aria)
883:             }
884:             component_type::LAZY_HSTACK => {
885:                 wrap_stack(id, "row", semantic, node, &children, &css, &event, &aria)
886:             }
887:             component_type::TEXT => {
888:                 // A TEXT's tag is resolved by typography + role: a heading
889:                 // `TEXT_STYLE` (LargeTitle…Headline) is always a heading; else
890:                 // `ROLE_HEADER` → `<h2>`, `ROLE_PARAGRAPH` → `<p>`; else `<span>`.
891:                 let tag = role_spec::text_tag(kind, node.role_code(), node.text_style_code())
892:                     .unwrap_or("span");
893:                 let text = escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
894:                 format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria}{style}>{text}</{tag}>")
895:             }
896:             component_type::BUTTON => {
897:                 // Composite Override Mode: children present → custom body.
898:                 let body = if node.children.is_empty() {
899:                     escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default())
900:                 } else {
901:                     children
902:                 };
903:                 let button_class = class_attr("pathland-button");
904:                 format!("<button{data_id}{event}{aria}{button_class}{style}>{body}</button>")
905:             }
906:             component_type::TOGGLE => {
907:                 let toggle_style = node.f32_property(property_id::TOGGLE_STYLE, 0.0).round() as u8;
908:                 let checked = if node.checked() { " checked" } else { "" };
909:                 let body = if node.children.is_empty() {
910:                     format!(
911:                         "<span class=\"pathland-text\">{}</span>",
912:                         escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default())
913:                     )
914:                 } else {
915:                     format!("<div class=\"pathland-custom-body\">{children}</div>")
916:                 };
917:                 let toggle_class = class_attr("pathland-toggle");
918:                 match toggle_style {
919:                     1 => format!(
920:                         "<label{data_id}{event}{aria}{toggle_class}{style}><input type=\"checkbox\"{checked}>{body}</label>"
921:                     ),
922:                     2 => {
923:                         let pressed = if node.checked() { "true" } else { "false" };
924:                         format!(
925:                             "<button{data_id}{event}{aria} type=\"button\" aria-pressed=\"{pressed}\"{style}>{body}</button>"
926:                         )
927:                     }
928:                     _ => format!(
929:                         "<label{data_id}{event}{aria}{toggle_class}{style}><input type=\"checkbox\" role=\"switch\"{checked}>{body}</label>"
930:                     ),
931:                 }
932:             }
933:             component_type::SPACER => {
934:                 let tag = semantic.unwrap_or("div");
935:                 let combined = format!("flex:1;{css}");
936:                 let spacer_style = style_attr(&combined);
937:                 format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria}{spacer_style}></{tag}>")
938:             }
939:             component_type::SLIDER => {
940:                 let min = node.f32_property(property_id::MIN_VALUE, 0.0);
941:                 let max = node.f32_property(property_id::MAX_VALUE, 1.0);
942:                 let value = node.f32_property(property_id::VALUE, min);
943:                 let body = if node.children.is_empty() {
944:                     format!(
945:                         "<span class=\"pathland-text\">{}</span>",
946:                         escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default())
947:                     )
948:                 } else {
949:                     format!("<div class=\"pathland-custom-body\">{children}</div>")
950:                 };
951:                 let slider_class = class_attr("pathland-slider");
952:                 format!(
953:                     "<label{data_id}{event}{aria}{slider_class}{style}><input type=\"range\" min=\"{min}\" max=\"{max}\" step=\"any\" value=\"{value}\">{body}</label>"
954:                 )
955:             }
956:             component_type::TEXT_FIELD => {
957:                 let value = escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
958:                 let label = escape(
959:                     node.strings
960:                         .get(&property_id::LABEL)
961:                         .map(String::as_str)
962:                         .unwrap_or_default(),
963:                 );
964:                 let prompt = escape(
965:                     node.strings
966:                         .get(&property_id::PROMPT)
967:                         .map(String::as_str)
968:                         .unwrap_or_default(),
969:                 );
970:                 let input_type = if node.f32_property(property_id::IS_SECURE, 0.0) != 0.0 {
971:                     "password"
972:                 } else {
973:                     "text"
974:                 };
975:                 let textfield_class = class_attr("pathland-textfield");
976:                 format!(
977:                     "<label{data_id}{event}{aria}{textfield_class}{style}><span class=\"pathland-label\">{label}</span><input class=\"pathland-input\" type=\"{input_type}\" value=\"{value}\" placeholder=\"{prompt}\"></label>"
978:                 )
979:             }
980:             component_type::TEXT_EDITOR => {
981:                 let value = escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
982:                 format!("<textarea{data_id}{event}{aria} class=\"pathland-input\" rows=\"4\"{style}>{value}</textarea>")
983:             }
984:             component_type::IMAGE => {
985:                 let src = escape(
986:                     node.strings
987:                         .get(&property_id::IMAGE_SOURCE)
988:                         .map(String::as_str)
989:                         .unwrap_or_default(),
990:                 );
991:                 format!("<img{data_id}{event}{aria} src=\"{src}\"{style}>")
992:             }
993:             component_type::COLOR => {
994:                 let tag = semantic.unwrap_or("div");
995:                 let color = node.u32_property(property_id::COLOR, 0xFF00_0000);
996:                 // Layout-greedy (SwiftUI Color): expands to the available space
997:                 // unless a size modifier constrains it.
998:                 format!(
999:                     "<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria} style=\"flex:1 1 auto;align-self:stretch;background-color:{};{css}\">{children}</{tag}>",
1000:                     rgba(color)
1001:                 )
1002:             }
1003:             component_type::SHAPE => {
1004:                 let kind = node.f32_property(property_id::SHAPE_KIND, 0.0).round() as u8;
1005:                 let fill = node.u32_property(property_id::COLOR, 0xFF00_0000);
1006:                 let w = node.f32_property(property_id::WIDTH, 100.0);
1007:                 let h = node.f32_property(property_id::HEIGHT, 100.0);
1008:                 let base = format!(
1009:                     "width:{};height:{};background-color:{};{css}",
1010:                     size_css(w),
1011:                     size_css(h),
1012:                     rgba(fill)
1013:                 );
1014:                 // A semantic role retags the CSS-shape divs; the Path branch is an
1015:                 // `<svg>` and ignores the role.
1016:                 let tag = semantic.unwrap_or("div");
1017:                 match kind {
1018:                     0 | 4 => format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria} style=\"{base}border-radius:50%;\"></{tag}>"),
1019:                     2 => {
1020:                         let r = node.f32_property(property_id::BORDER_RADIUS, 8.0);
1021:                         format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria} style=\"{base}border-radius:{r}px;\"></{tag}>")
1022:                     }
1023:                     3 => format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria} style=\"{base}border-radius:9999px;\"></{tag}>"),
1024:                     5 => format!(
1025:                         "<svg{data_id}{event}{aria} width=\"100\" height=\"100\" viewBox=\"0 0 100 100\"><rect width=\"100\" height=\"100\" fill=\"{}\"/></svg>",
1026:                         rgba(fill)
1027:                     ),
1028:                     _ => format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria} style=\"{base}\"></{tag}>"),
1029:                 }
1030:             }
1031:             component_type::DIVIDER => {
1032:                 let width = node.f32_property(property_id::BORDER_WIDTH, 1.0);
1033:                 let color = node
1034:                     .properties
1035:                     .get(&property_id::COLOR)
1036:                     .copied()
1037:                     .map(rgba)
1038:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)".to_string());
1039:                 format!(
1040:                     "<div{data_id}{event}{aria} style=\"height:0;border-top:{width}px solid {color};\"></div>"
1041:                 )
1042:             }
1043:             component_type::PROGRESS_VIEW => {
1044:                 let indeterminate = node.f32_property(property_id::IS_INDETERMINATE, 0.0) != 0.0
1045:                     || node.f32_property(property_id::PROGRESS, -1.0) < 0.0;
1046: if indeterminate {
1047:                     let spinner_class = class_attr("pathland-spinner");
1048:                     format!("<div{data_id}{spinner_class}{style}></div>")
1049:                 } else {
1050:                     let value = node.f32_property(property_id::PROGRESS, 0.0);
1051:                     let max = node.f32_property(property_id::MAX_VALUE, 1.0);
1052:                     format!(
1053:                         "<progress{data_id}{event}{aria} value=\"{value}\" max=\"{max}\"{style}></progress>"
1054:                     )
1055:                 }
1056:             }
1057:             component_type::GAUGE => {
1058:                 let min = node.f32_property(property_id::MIN_VALUE, 0.0);
1059:                 let max = node.f32_property(property_id::MAX_VALUE, 1.0);
1060:                 let value = node.f32_property(property_id::VALUE, min);
1061:                 let pct = if max > min {
1062:                     ((value - min) / (max - min)).clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 100.0
1063:                 } else {
1064:                     0.0
1065:                 };
1066:                 let gauge_class = class_attr("pathland-gauge");
1067:                 // The bounds ride as `data-min`/`data-max` so the DOM client can
1068:                 // recompute the percentage when VALUE changes (its gauge handler
1069:                 // reads them), mirroring the stepper's `.pathland-stepper-range`.
1070:                 format!(
1071:                     "<div{data_id}{event}{aria}{gauge_class} data-min=\"{min}\" data-max=\"{max}\"{style}><div style=\"width:{pct}%\"></div></div>"
1072:                 )
1073:             }
1074:             component_type::GRID | component_type::LAZY_VGRID | component_type::LAZY_HGRID => {
1075:                 let tag = semantic.unwrap_or("div");
1076:                 let cols = grid_columns(node);
1077:                 let grid_css = grid_style(cols, node.component == component_type::LAZY_HGRID);
1078:                 let combined = format!("{grid_css}{css}");
1079:                 let grid_style = style_attr(&combined);
1080:                 format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria}{grid_style}>{children}</{tag}>")
1081:             }
1082:             component_type::SCROLLVIEW => {
1083:                 let tag = semantic.unwrap_or("div");
1084:                 let combined = format!("overflow:auto;{css}");
1085:                 let scroll_style = style_attr(&combined);
1086:                 format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria}{scroll_style}>{children}</{tag}>")
1087:             }
1088:             component_type::ZSTACK => {
1089:                 let tag = semantic.unwrap_or("div");
1090:                 let inner: String = node
1091:                     .children
1092:                     .iter()
1093:                     .map(|&child| {
1094:                         let child_html = self.render_node(nodes, child);
1095:                         if child_html.is_empty() {
1096:                             String::new()
1097:                         } else {
1098:                             format!("<div style=\"position:absolute;inset:0\">{child_html}</div>")
1099:                         }
1100:                     })
1101:                     .collect();
1102:                 let combined = format!("position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;{css}");
1103:                 let zstyle = style_attr(&combined);
1104:                 format!("<{tag}{data_id}{event}{aria}{zstyle}>{inner}</{tag}>")
1105:             }
1106:             component_type::STEPPER => {
1107:                 let min = node.f32_property(property_id::MIN_VALUE, 0.0);
1108:                 let max = node.f32_property(property_id::MAX_VALUE, 100.0);
1109:                 let value = node.f32_property(property_id::VALUE, min);
1110:                 let step = node.f32_property(property_id::STEP_VALUE, 1.0);
1111:                 // Composite shell matching the DOM client's `stepperShell()`
1112:                 // (lib/typescript/src/elements.ts): the +/- buttons and a hidden
1113:                 // `.pathland-stepper-range` span carrying the bounds for the
1114:                 // client's click math. The value is displayed in the first span,
1115:                 // rounded to 2 decimals like the client.
1116:                 let display = format!("{}", (value * 100.0).round() / 100.0);
1117:                 let stepper_class = class_attr("pathland-stepper");
1118:                 format!(
1119:                     "<div{data_id}{event}{aria}{stepper_class}{style}><button type=\"button\" data-step=\"-1\">−</button><span>{display}</span><button type=\"button\" data-step=\"1\">+</button><span class=\"pathland-stepper-range\" hidden data-min=\"{min}\" data-max=\"{max}\" data-step=\"{step}\"></span></div>"
1120:                 )
1121:             }
1122:             component_type::DATE_PICKER => {
1123:                 let mode = node.f32_property(property_id::DATE_PICKER_MODE, 0.0).round() as u8;
1124:                 let (t, value) = match node.date {
1125:                     Some((days, millis)) => match mode {
1126:                         1 => {
1127:                             let (hh, mm, _) = millis_to_hms(millis);
1128:                             ("time", format!("{hh:02}:{mm:02}"))
1129:                         }
1130:                         2 => {
1131:                             let (y, m, d) = days_to_date(days);
1132:                             let (hh, mm, _) = millis_to_hms(millis);
1133:                             (
1134:                                 "datetime-local",
1135:                                 format!("{y:04}-{m:02}-{d:02}T{hh:02}:{mm:02}"),
1136:                             )
1137:                         }
1138:                         _ => {
1139:                             let (y, m, d) = days_to_date(days);
1140:                             ("date", format!("{y:04}-{m:02}-{d:02}"))
1141:                         }
1142:                     },
1143:                     None => ("date", String::new()),
1144:                 };
1145:                 format!("<input{data_id}{event}{aria} type=\"{t}\" value=\"{value}\"{style}>")
1146:             }
1147:             component_type::PICKER => {
1148:                 let selected = node.u32_property(property_id::SELECTION, 0);
1149:                 let options: String = node
1150:                     .children
1151:                     .iter()
1152:                     .enumerate()
1153:                     .map(|(i, &child)| {
1154:                         let label = nodes
1155:                             .get(&child)
1156:                             .and_then(|n| n.text.clone())
1157:                             .unwrap_or_default();
1158:                         let sel = if i as u32 == selected { " selected" } else { "" };
1159:                         // Each option carries the child node's id so the DOM
1160:                         // client can hydrate/reconcile it against the child's
1161:                         // own TREE/STYLE deltas.
1162:                         format!(
1163:                             "<option data-pathland-id=\"{child}\" value=\"{i}\"{sel}>{}</option>",
1164:                             escape(&label)
1165:                         )
1166:                     })
1167:                     .collect();
1168:                 format!("<select{data_id}{event}{aria}{style}>{options}</select>")
1169:             }
1170:             component_type::MENU => {
1171:                 // Composite shell matching the DOM client's `menuShell()`
1172:                 // (lib/typescript/src/elements.ts): the trigger holds the label,
1173:                 // and TREE children are routed into `.pathland-menu-items` (the
1174:                 // client's `childrenContainer`). `role="menu"` is the control's
1175:                 // intrinsic semantics (not a `ROLE` property).
1176:                 let label = escape(node.text.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
1177:                 let menu_class = class_attr("pathland-menu");

617: function applyNumericProperty(el: HTMLElement, propId: number, valueType: number, bits: number): void {

639:       if (stepText) {

647:         const min = Number(gauge.dataset.min ?? 0);
